content: Click nested groups: @click.group() on a function registers a group; @outer.group() / @outer.command() attach children. Options attached to a group belong only to that group and must be parsed before the subcommand name. @click.group(invoke_without_command=True) makes the group callback run when no subcommand is given and exposes ctx.invoked_subcommand (None when absent), which is the pattern for 'sif eval --personal' where --personal selects the default action. CliRunner invokes a group with the option/subcommand args list; group options precede subcommands. The SIF CLI generator's traverse_commands recurses only groups with children, so a leaf group (no subcommands) is omitted from generated sections and needs a generator fix.
